property_summary: Once Initialized() has been called, SetMinSum must be inert (MinSum stays unchanged for every input); the mutant drops the guard so a later SetMinSum overwrites MinSum, breaking the rule for some input.
Once the contract is initialized, SetMinSum must revert and leave MinSum unchanged; the mutant removes the guard so a post-initialization SetMinSum succeeds and overwrites MinSum.

For any inputs, once MinSum is set and the contract initialized, no reentrant SetMinSum call made through Collect's external call may change MinSum (the nonReentrant lock forbids it); the mutant disables the lock so a re-entrant attacker can change MinSum during Collect, breaking the rule when m2 != m1.

While any nonReentrant function of C is executing, a reentrant call to SetMinSum must revert and therefore never change MinSum; the mutant disables the lock so a reentrant attacker during Collect can set MinSum to a new value.
For any value, a call to SetMinSum(_val) succeeds and sets MinSum to _val; in the mutant the nonReentrant_ modifier requires locked_==true, so SetMinSum always reverts and MinSum stays 0.

For any value v, a fresh contract's SetMinSum(v) succeeds and sets MinSum to v; the mutant permanently locks after the first non-reentrant call, so in any second call SetMinSum reverts and MinSum stays unchanged.
